South Indian English (Tech Talk).raw: Prime Minister Modi and distinguished leaders, it's wonderful to be back in India. Every time I visit, I'm struck by the pace of change and today is no different. Back when I was a student, I often took the Coramandel Express train from Chennai up to IAD Kharagpur. To get there, we passed through Vishakapatnam, Waisak. I remember it being a quiet and modest coastal city, brimming with potential. Now in that same city, Google is establishing a full-stack AI hub, part of our $15 billion infrastructure investment in India. When finished, this hub will house gigawatt scale compute and a new international subsea cable gateway, bringing jobs and cutting a J.I. to people and businesses across India. Sitting on that train, I never imagined Waisak becoming a global AI hub. Just as I couldn't have imagined that one day I'd be spending time with teams figuring out how to put data centers into space, or taking my parents for a fully autonomous car ride in San Francisco. Seeing a Vamo ride through my 83-year-old dad's eyes, I saw the progress in a whole new light. Of course, he said he'd be more impressed if it worked on India's busy roads, still working on that one day. The progress shows what's possible when humanity dreams big, and no technology has me dreaming bigger than AI. It is the biggest platform shift of our lifetimes. We are on the cusp of hyper-progress and new discoveries that can help emerging economies leapfrog legacy gaps. But that outcome is neither guaranteed nor automatic. To build AI that is truly helpful for everyone, we must pursue it boldly, approach it responsibly, and work through this defining moment together.

Hinglish Stand-up Comedy.raw: میں دکھا پکے ہو گیا ہمی کلگی تیر دادیری مرستے سک کی آئی میں کامتکتے تھا میری ہمی تو دیا گیا گیا گیا تو یہ شادی بہل ہا تو پک چل دیا کنگ ہمی گولہ میں نے ہمیہ دمامت کھا کر فا دکھا دو دن گیا تو اسمیں ناٹا کٹ کٹ کٹ کیا آیا سو یہ بولگیں بارچا گیا میری ہمی رو دی کنگ کو بھرالگا بارچا گیا کنگے کیا ہمی گولہ دی اور پنتوں گھر میں کھا آپ نے بھین نہیں دی تو ہمارے کر میں سنسٹی بیٹی اور میکپ کا سمان دونوں نہیں پاچھا گیا ہم نے مواب ایسے دے گیا اور ایک کام کرتی ہی ساتھ می سے درنایا بیج کا کچھ رہای گیا ماری اور میری ممی فول ملوٹرمیٹک اور ہم نے پلکولی ہی مطلب اکتم پوری اکتیم ان کی دوج کی تو ہم بمارے جیتے میں سے کر راتی تی او اکتیم کر رہنے کی ہا بیٹا اور ہمیں کوئی اٹتش میسی ہم کلکولی آنی موستول بچے بیک بیکٹان کی اصمنا چدی رہی میں آلاگی لیٹی بمی دکجاری دوپیر میں لیٹی ہمیں آگا گڑبڑا آجتی اور ممی ممی ایسے افیکشنیدلی تچ بین کر رہن سے اوگلی سے کر رہنے ممی ممی ہمیں بیٹا کھانا ہے کھانا آنائمی گناتے ہمیں کھانا آگی بیٹا ہے اس بات ہمیں نا چیزے

Bengali English (Interview).raw: I played with some great players. I'll tell you a story here and for me that was very important part of leadership and I spoke to you about man management. There was Sewaq batting with me in the middle and we were chasing that night 320 where I took my shirt off. And I was very upset at lunch because England got 325 and in those days this was about 2002. You very rarely chased 325. It's not like modern day cricket where you just keep hitting and the game has changed a lot. So I was walking down this long room at Lodz and Sewaq was whistling behind me. He had his back. He was that sort of a person. He was whistling behind me. So I turned up to me and then Hindi I abused him and said 1-325 was to make a bet but you think it's a joke. So he walks past me and said, we're going to win this. I said, let's see. So we went. We started very well both of us. And after 7 overs we were about 70 for Nolars. I was batting on 40 odd and Sewaq was also batting. So Ronnie Rani and many of you would have known in England. Ronnie Rani was bowling from this end and I went up to Viru and said you know we've got a good start. I think we can get this total but don't get out. You know we've played the harder bowlers. There's a weaker bowler coming in. Let's just keep taking 6-7 runs and over because that's what we need. He said, yeah, I find no problem. So Ronnie runs up from this end. He hits the first ball over mid off for 4. So I was at the non-striker end. I went up to him, tapped and said, good shot. So he got 4 runs and over. Just keep rotating. He said, yeah, I say there's no problem. So he goes back to his end. The next ball Ronnie pitches it up. He hits it over the top over mid on. 1 bounce 4. So I again go up to him and said, well played, well played, good shot. We've got 8.
